description: Get all reviewed public product scopes for a provider in a payment category by exact slug, with supporting facts, sources and checked dates. An empty list means no mapped evidence, not absence of a capability. Profiles outside payment categories are not found.

slug.description: Exact provider slug returned by search_payment_capabilities; copy it rather than guessing. Use the lowercase hyphenated identifier (1-120 characters), not a title or full URL.

name: get_payment_capabilities
